description:
Per-stock DAILY FII/FPI transaction flow (raw Rs) -- daily series + trailing-30d summary.

    Accepts NSE symbol, ISIN, or BSE code. `days` (1..1825, default 90) bounds the daily
    `series`; `summary` is always the trailing-30d figure (the SAME single-source helper
    get_company_profile's compact `fii_activity` field uses). A distinct FII/FPI surface from
    get_market_fii_dii_flow (market-wide) and get_shareholding (quarterly holding %) -- this is
    per-STOCK daily transaction flow, aggregated from CDSL's trade-wise disclosure.

    COVERAGE CAVEAT: CDSL-only (NSDL unreachable, not ingested) -- every response carries a
    `coverage_note`. `net = buy - sell` is the only computation (SEBI-RA line: no direction
    calls, no "smart money" framing).

    Renamed from `get_fii_activity` (issue #285) so the name carries "flow" like its
    get_sector_fii_flow/get_market_fii_dii_flow siblings ("activity" gave no scope cue).
    `get_fii_activity` is kept as a deprecated back-compat alias for this release.
name: get_stock_fii_flow
